description: Run any gh command: { args: ["pr", "list", "-R", "owner/name"], stdin?, timeout_ms? } -> { stdout, stderr, exit_code, duration_ms, timed_out, stdout_truncated, stderr_truncated }. A non-zero exit or a timeout is DATA here, not an error. The escape hatch for everything without a typed github::* function.

stdin.description: Bytes piped to gh's stdin (for flags like `--body-file -`).

timeout_ms.description: Per-call timeout in ms, clamped to the configured max_timeout_ms.

response_schema.description: A completed `gh` invocation. This is also the `github::exec` response: a non-zero exit or a timeout is DATA here — only failure to run the process at all is a `GhError`.

duration_ms.description: Wall-clock duration of the invocation, in ms.

exit_code.description: Process exit code; null when the process was killed (timeout).

stderr_truncated.description: True when stderr exceeded `max_output_bytes` and was truncated.

stdout_truncated.description: True when stdout exceeded `max_output_bytes` and was truncated.

timed_out.description: True when the timeout expired and the process group was killed.

response_schema.title: GhOutcome
